summary: Deployed a simple inventory application (static HTML table) on node1 via httpd, configured Apache to listen on TCP 8181, relabeled that port's SELinux type from intermapper_port_t to http_port_t (semanage port -m), and verified the app serves correctly with SELinux remaining in Enforcing mode and no AVC denials. Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured a healthy baseline, rebooted node1, confirmed the boot ID changed, and verified the inventory app, SELinux enforcing mode, and the port label all recovered post-restart.
actions_performed: Inspected node1: confirmed SELinux Enforcing, no existing inventory app, no web server installed
Created inventory application content at /var/www/html/index.html and restored SELinux context
Diagnosed httpd bind failure as SELinux permission denial (port 8181 was labeled intermapper_port_t)
Reassigned port 8181 to http_port_t via 'semanage port -m -t http_port_t -p tcp 8181'
Enabled and started httpd; verified curl access on $NODE_IP:8181 and SELinux still Enforcing with no AVC denials
Captured pre-restart baseline (boot_id, SELinux mode, httpd status, app response, port label)
Triggered a background systemd reboot on node1 so the acknowledgement returned before disconnection
Polled node1 until exec connectivity returned
Verified changed boot_id and confirmed post-restart recovery: SELinux Enforcing, httpd active, port 8181 listening and labeled http_port_t, inventory app serving content, no AVC denials

evidence.requirement: Inventory app served on TCP 8181 with SELinux enforcing (functional requirement)
evidence.summary: httpd active, port 8181 listening, curl returns inventory HTML, getenforce=Enforcing, no AVC denials

evidence.requirement: SELinux MAC root cause diagnosis and fix
evidence.summary: journalctl showed 'Permission denied' binding 8181 (SELinux, since apachectl configtest passed); confirmed port 8181 was labeled intermapper_port_t, not http_port_t; fixed via semanage port -m and re-verified successful bind
Captured boot_id 4a743885-c59f-43ee-afde-ef96f7bea723, Enforcing SELinux, httpd active, working curl to 8181, correct port label
Reboot command acknowledged before disconnect; subsequent probe failed with connection reset, confirming the node went down

evidence.requirement: node1 restart identity change and command availability restored
evidence.summary: Polled through timeout until exec succeeded again; new boot_id 1d30a906-a668-4064-a9d7-09bfc69051d9 differs from baseline, proving an actual reboot occurred

evidence.requirement: node1 post-restart recovery of required service and SELinux mode
evidence.summary: After reboot: getenforce=Enforcing, httpd active, port 8181 listening and labeled http_port_t, curl to $NODE_IP:8181 returns the inventory HTML, no AVC denials since boot
